title: answers stream citation projection (v1)
description: One citation of a streamed answers run inside the buffered JSON envelope's projection: the projected members of the citation tag's payload, each present only when the payload offered it. Unlike the blocking form, the url is optional here — a streamed citation is projected on arrival, and dropping a url-less one would desynchronize the citation count the projection reports.

number.$comment: The citation's ordinal as the payload numbered it, zero included.
